review_evidence: README explicitly describes Taleve as a formal model of stacker games in Lean for researchers to formalize and publish results.
The hydrated source contains five Lean files with proposition-level declarations alongside its game-state and rules model.
The repository is intentionally a formal model rather than ordinary application code, so its definitions and checked properties are primary content.
summary: Retain Taleve as a compact formal Lean model of stacker games with checked properties.
